guidelines.detail: refines FID-02 (The description specifies prerequisite order, parallel ordering, work occurring during production, and a conditional next step. The missing-flow records show these relationships were not preserved. This makes FID-02’s general instruction to preserve described dependencies more actionable for parallel and overlapping work.)

new guideline (The description explicitly distinguishes ordering parts from the later point when the parts arrive. The generated “Receive parts” label is matched to the reference’s ordering activity even though the generated model already includes an ordering activity (P3), suggesting arrival was modeled as a second activity rather than as the stated prerequisite event. The other label pairs largely preserve the)

same as LRN-071 (The description specifies ordering and overlap, while the missing-flow records show those relationships were not preserved. LRN-071 already states essentially this guideline, so it is not a new guideline.)

new guideline (The description distinguishes ordering parts from the subsequent arrival and inspection. The generated “Receive parts” task is matched to the reference’s ordering task, indicating a conflation of the order action with the arrival. This guideline captures the described arrival without treating it as a separate performed activity.)

same as LRN-005 (The description gives activity order, parallel work, and a conditional outcome; the records show corresponding sequence flows missing. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-005.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The label pairs show a risk of changing the stated meaning, notably confusing receiving parts with ordering them; the description distinguishes these actions. FID-03 already advises using short, faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that work proceeds through multiple dependent activities, including activities that must occur in parallel or overlap: Model their sequence flows and parallel branches to preserve the stated dependencies, synchronizing branches only when later work depends on their completion.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that work proceeds through multiple dependent activities, including activities that must occur in parallel or overlap

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that work proceeds after items arrive, without stating a separate action to receive them: Model the arrival as an intermediate catch event when it is a prerequisite for subsequent work; do not add a separate receiving activity unless the description explicitly describes one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that work proceeds after items arrive, without stating a separate action to receive them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that an external item or resource arrives before subsequent work, without describing a separate receiving action: Model the arrival as an intermediate catch event that the process waits for, rather than inventing a receiving task; use a message catch event only when the description establishes that the arrival is communicated as a message.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an external item or resource arrives before subsequent work, without describing a separate receiving action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an order among process stages, describes branches that converge, or says that multiple required activities must finish before a later stage or process completion: Model the sequence flows that connect the corresponding elements, preserving the stated order and branch-and-join structure. Use gateway types that match whether the description specifies a choice or requires all branches to complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an order among process stages, describes branches that converge, or says that multiple required activities must finish before a later stage or process completion

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, event, or decision with a specific action, object, or outcome
